info.name: Nearby Chat API - Complete Collection
info.description: Complete API collection for Nearby Chat application with all endpoints including Authentication, Users, Chats, Messages, Groups, and Coins management.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Silent login for guest users. Creates a temporary account with 50 coins. No registration needed.
Register a new user or upgrade from guest account. Receives 150 welcome coins. If referralCode is provided, referrer gets 25 coins.
Login with email, phone, or username and password.
Send OTP for verification. Type: 'email' or 'phone'. Purpose: 'registration', 'login', or 'reset_password'.
Verify OTP sent to email or phone. Maximum 5 attempts allowed.
Get current authenticated user details.
Logout current user and clear cache.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for guest login, registration, login, OTP verification, and logout.

item.name: Users

request.description: Get profile details of a specific user by userId.
Update current user's profile (username, bio, avatar).
Update user's current location. Cached in Redis for faster nearby searches.
Find nearby users within specified radius (in meters). Maximum 50 users returned.

query.description: Search by username or email (min 2 characters)

request.description: Search users by username or email. Returns up to 20 results.
Update user settings and preferences.
Block a specific user.
Unblock a previously blocked user.
Upload user avatar image. Accepts image files.

item.description: User management endpoints for profiles, location, search, settings, and blocking.

item.name: Chats

request.description: Get all active chats for the current user with pagination.
Get details of a specific chat by chatId.
Get existing private chat with a user or create a new one.
Initiate anonymous random chat request. Costs 10 coins (15 with filters). Auto-matches if compatible user found in pool.
Get all active chat requests in the pool (for map view). Excludes own requests.
Accept a chat request from the pool and start anonymous timed chat.
Extend random chat duration. 24 hours = 50 coins, 48 hours = 90 coins.
Delete a chat. For groups, only admin can delete.
Mute or unmute a chat.
Clear unread message count for a chat.

item.description: Chat management endpoints for private chats, random chats, and chat pool.

item.name: Messages

request.description: Get all messages for a specific chat with pagination.
Send a text message. Type can be: 'text', 'image', 'video', 'audio', 'file', 'location'. Note: Real-time messaging handled via Socket.IO.
Upload and send media message (image, video, audio, file).
Delete a message. Set deleteForEveryone=true to delete for all (only sender can do this).
Mark multiple messages as read.

item.description: Message endpoints for sending, receiving, and managing messages.

item.name: Groups

request.description: Create a new group chat. Requires at least 2 participants. Creator becomes admin.
Update group name or avatar. Only admin can update.
Add new members to group. Only admin can add members.
Remove a member from group. Only admin can remove members. Admin cannot be removed.
Leave a group. If admin leaves, admin rights transfer to next member. If last member, group is deleted.
Upload group avatar. Only admin can upload.

item.description: Group chat management endpoints for creating, updating, and managing group members.

item.name: Coins

request.description: Get current coin balance and recent transactions.
Get dynamic coin pricing for purchases. No authentication required.
Get paginated coin transaction history.
Claim daily bonus of 10 coins. Can be claimed once per day.
Add coins to user account. Requires full account (not guest). Type: 'purchase', 'bonus', 'earn'.
Deduct coins from user account. Returns error if insufficient coins.
Claim reward for watching an ad. Default reward is 10 coins.

item.description: Coin management endpoints for balance, transactions, rewards, and purchases.

request.description: Health check endpoint to verify server status and uptime.
